# פרסום פלוס — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A solo graphic designer offering fast, affordable, and professional advertising flyers starting at 75₪, targeting the Haredi (ultra-Orthodox Jewish) community. The brand identity is warm, trustworthy, and straightforward — not corporate or tech-heavy. The visual language is clean and dignified, using white, black, soft gold, and gray. The service is positioned as quick, accessible, and community-oriented, catering to synagogues, small shops, bakeries, Torah classes, events, job listings, and more. The entire experience is designed to feel simple, reliable, and worth every shekel.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About פרסום פלוס
A solo graphic designer offering fast, affordable, and professional advertising flyers starting at 75₪, targeting the Haredi (ultra-Orthodox Jewish) community. The brand identity is warm, trustworthy, and straightforward — not corporate or tech-heavy. The visual language is clean and dignified, using white, black, soft gold, and gray. The service is positioned as quick, accessible, and community-oriented, catering to synagogues, small shops, bakeries, Torah classes, events, job listings, and more. The entire experience is designed to feel simple, reliable, and worth every shekel.

## Target Audience
- הציבור החרדי — בעלי עסקים קטנים, מאפיות, בתי כנסת, שיעורי תורה, חנויות, הסעות, מוסדות, דרושים עובדים, גמ"חים, מכירות, אירועים
- בעלי עסקים חרדיים
- קהילות בתי כנסת
- מאפיות כשרות

## Industry
Graphic Design & Advertising
